brief: A seven-cell honeycomb work surface, covered on top, with every open outside edge finished with caps.

finish.summary: Seven-cell level-0 honeycomb (center plus a ring of six full pieces), joined by six joint bolts from the center, a top cover on every cell, and caps on all 18 open outside edges. check_build reports no issues and meshClash is clear.

requirements.evidence: 7 full pieces: center (0,0,0) and six neighbours (-1,0),(-1,1),(0,-1),(0,1),(1,-1),(1,0), all at level 0. The six center-to-ring joints are bolted (jointBolt:0#0,0#0–5), which cleared the LOOSE_BODY warnings. The six joints around the ring are not bolted.

requirements.requirement: Every open outside edge finished with caps
requirements.evidence: All 18 cap sockets offered were filled (3 per ring cell). Afterwards no cap sockets were left open.
check_build: ok, no issues, meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
